lines.name: Energy tariff, residential
lines.note: Residential load served, in MWh. Unserved load earns no tariff and no value of lost load is booked (resilience is not valued). Price is site-specific, usually a discount to retail.

lines.name: Energy tariff, hospital
lines.note: Hospital load served, in MWh. Unserved load earns no tariff and no value of lost load is booked. Price is site-specific.

lines.name: Plant capex
lines.note: Plant capex not in the energy model's asset capex (grid connection, balance of plant, installation): the base of the insurance share. Capex is priced once: do not re-enter the generators or the battery. No sourced default: enter the price and life.

lines.name: Staff
lines.note: FTE count per year. No sourced default: enter the quantity and the price.

lines.name: Maintenance
lines.note: Share of the plant capex above per year. The assets' own fixed O&M is already in the energy model's locked rows. No sourced default: enter the share.

lines.name: Insurance
lines.note: Share of the plant capex above per year. No sourced default for a microgrid: enter the share.

line.name: Availability / EaaS fee
line.note: Off until you add it. Typed: a fee per contracted service-month for a provider that builds, owns and operates. The locked rows from the energy model and this row's help are what stop duplication: do not also bill a tariff on the same energy. A linked served-load row against a valued EaaS fee is refused double_count:eaas_fee.
